doc.title: Hank Cicalo interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 30, 2022

title: Listening at home after a ten-hour day
summary: Hank says he did not need silence after sessions and listened to jazz or rock as he pleased.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: Okay last question, if you put in a ten hour day in the studio, when you got out did you want to hear silence?
You mean when I went home?
When you got home. Did you just like oh my ears, I’ve got to hear nothing?

No I would clear myself out, if I’m doing like a rock & roll date, and I used to live in Woodland Hills, that was a long way from the studio. I would listen to jazz and stuff. I never blocked out one thing or the other. If I was doing jazz I was doing jazz. If I was doing rock & roll — © Fillius Jazz Archive -19-
